customRules.title: Next.js public secret-like variable
customRules.detail: NEXT_PUBLIC values are bundled into browser code, so secret-looking names should stop the review.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Keep credentials server-side and expose only non-sensitive public config.

customRules.title: Next.js redirect from URL input
customRules.detail: Middleware or route redirects built from URL parameters can become open redirects.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Allowlist internal paths or trusted origins before redirecting.

customRules.title: Unsafe HTML rendering
customRules.detail: Direct HTML rendering in a Next.js app needs sanitization and XSS-focused tests.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Use safe rendering or sanitize trusted HTML at the boundary.
